name: @the-inclusionist/game-2048
description: 2048 · Potência de 2 — a sliding-merge number puzzle on the accessibility-first Inclusionist engine. Reimplemented from the rules, not forked from any of the MIT descendants of Threes!.
comment:name: Package `@the-inclusionist/game-2048` (ADR-0068 §3 with ADR-0071's scope) in repository
`the-inclusionist/game-2048` (ADR-0081). They MIRROR each other, so there is nothing to hold in the head.
⚠️ This paragraph used to justify a DIVERGENCE, and there is none left to justify. The repository was
`pixi-2048` until 2026-09-06 and the two names pointed different ways; ADR-0081 superseded that choice
whole. The chess did the same — it is `the-inclusionist/game-chess` now, not `hartwig-zdog-chess` — so
`game-<slug>` is what both game repositories carry. The reason the short form works is ADR-0071 §1's:
inside the organisation the container is already named, so `the-inclusionist/the-inclusionist-game-2048`
would say the word twice.
comment:private: `private: true` UNTIL there is something to publish. ADR-0068 §3 says a game publishes itself as a
package so the catalogue's manifest can select it, and that day this line comes off — with the same
care the engine's did (ADR-0072 §4). A scaffold that could be published by accident is worse than one
that cannot be published at all.

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && vitest run && vite build

comment:dependencies: THE ENGINE COMES BY `file:`, not from the registry, and that is the current state rather than the plan.
ADR-0072 chose public npmjs and nothing is published yet; `game-chess` already consumes the
engine the same way. The day `@the-inclusionist/engine` is published, this line becomes a semver range
and nothing else in this repository changes.
`pixi.js` is pinned to the engine's EXACT version: two PixiJS in one page is a bug, not a fallback.
